problem:
Determine the area $A$ of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$ and $\text{v}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 4\end{aligned}].$

$\,\,A=$ {{field-1}}
worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 5 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}-2 & 5 \\ 3 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-2)\cdot 4-5\cdot 3 \\  & =-8-15 \\  & =-23\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|\,-23\,|=23
$$
